every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 clears the text card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the anchor rack on the left in frame 4 is not covered by the UI panel as it is in site 1's frame 4.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9—pressing raw token blocks into digests in frames 3 to 5, filing anchors in frame 6, and routing seven host lanes in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D machinery, beveled dark-metal materials, lighting, and floor shadows across all 9 frames.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography and card design are identical in frames 1-3, 5-6, and 8-9, site 2 hides the left text panel during transition frames 4 and 7 to give the 3D scene breathing room and prevent overlap.

overall.reason: Both sites share the same visual design and 3D explanatory scene, edit-for-edit, except site 2 properly fades out the text cards during camera transitions so the 3D machinery is never occluded.
